title: I was disappointed when I opened this
text:
I was disappointed when I opened this. I was disappointed when I opened this!
First off, there is a mistake.....it does not hold six 8oz cups. It only holds four. I should have read the details better.
Second, you can't see it in the pictures, but there are three ridges by the top. Eh. I thought it would be smooth all around, but it's not. Oh well.
Overall, it's not fully what I wanted, but I'll make it work.

product_metadata.title: English Tea Store 6 Cup Teapot White Gloss Finish
